punchline: Kabat-Zinn writes that we are more asleep than awake even when we are awake.
thirty_sec: Jon Kabat-Zinn's book says people run on automatic pilot so much of the time. Part III has two chapter titles that sum it up: stuck in stress reactivity, and responding to stress instead of reacting. Our habitual automatic reactions, it says, largely decide how much stress we feel. Its small example from the pain chapters is seeing a headache as just a headache.
